profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Capital One

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed APIs and microservices that improved efficiency and scalability using C#, .net core, NServiceBus, MongoDB 
- Wrote unit and integration tests following Test Driven Development for high code coverage and faster speed to production
- Helped improve better code architecture design and infrastructure through code refactoring, code reviews and use of bounded context following Domain-Driven Design
- Follow agile methodology and validate and present to internal stakeholders new technology and products implemented for production

positions.title: Virtual Student Federal Service Intern - Microsoft Access Database Development
positions.description:
- Database in Microsoft Access 2013 that will support the details of a course catalog
- Relational database to capture many different information sets that pertain to each course
- Extendable database structure to accommodate future additional information sets

positions.title: Data Visualization Assistant
positions.description:
- Created D3 visualizations on scholars@cornell website  
- D3, CSS, JSON, Javascript

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- MEAN stack (MongoDB, ExpressJS, AngularJS, NodeJS)
- HTML, Javascript, CSS, Postman, Webpack, GIT
- Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
- SharePoint Development, Internal APIs, Bootstrap CSS Framework
- Created Washroom Information Display System (WIDS) Display Web application
	∙ Created a NodeJS web application using Express Framework to create web application
        ∙ Ensured a good user experience while ensuring security in web development

honors.title: Intel International Science and Engineering Fair (ISEF) - International 4th Place Grand Award in Behavior and Social Sciences
honors.description:
∙ Was one of the 5 finalists who were selected from Minnesota State Science & Engineering Region to go to the world’s largest international pre-college science competition to represent Minnesota.
∙  Received 4th place Grand Award out of 311 entries in the category of Behavior and Social Sciences with the project "Birth of a Revolution: A Global Model for Forecasting Political Instability," 
∙ The project attempts to predict the level of unrest that could occur in any country at any time by quantifying the amount of social unrest found in a country based on socioeconomic indicators. We created a real-time model and a simple user interface where the user could drag around various variables like GDP and unemployment to see the effect it had on unrest levels.

honors.title: US Physics Team Competition Semifinalist - National Physics Olympiad
honors.description: ∙ Was a semifinalist for the National US Physics Team Competition

projects.title: OCaml Functional Programming
projects.description:
- Led team meetings to brainstorm ideas and to divide the group work and maintained communication with the project team members to organize meetings and to check up on the progress of the project.  
- An AI Ocaml Programming Game. We provide users a game where they can creatively write AI code for virtual battlebots and compete against each other’s designs

projects.title: Web Programming and Development
projects.description:
- Organized and led team meetings, coordinated assignments to optimize group work, and maintained communication between project group members.
- Client: CRT Project Team
- Developed a fully functioning website for client’s use. Technology used include SQL, PHP, AJAX, Javascript, CSS,  and HTML.  Client is able to view the information and is able to edit, view and search easily through the data within their website. Used PhpMyAdmin as a database to store information and connect it to the website.
